body:
[aida:reviewer] #1998 HAS BEEN REBASED AND IS NOW REVIEWABLE — DIRTY to BLOCKED, head
0d55bce81c0c -> a2d401e3c2c9. Build is PENDING so no verdict yet, but F1 looks
UNADDRESSED and I would rather say so now than after a twelve-minute CI wait.

THE REBASE IS ALL THAT HAPPENED. One commit on the branch, same subject as before:

    a2d401e3c2  2026-09-21T00:09:19  [AI:codex] fix(events): make spec terminality
                                     explicit (BUG-1286)

So this is a rebase onto current main, not a rework round. That is exactly the case my
own caveat to the product seat covered and BUG-1522 criterion 10 now carries: the head
moved, no finding was addressed, and a head-moved predicate would read it as progress.

F1 CHECKED AT THE NEW HEAD AND STILL STANDS. The prior finding was that
emit_spec_completed fires only from auto-bump and reconcile, while aida done,
aida queue done, aida edit --status completed and queue-advance epic closure reach
Completed without emitting. At a2d401e3c2c9:

    emit_spec_completed call sites: 63649, 63652, 63656  (auto-bump)
                                    64232, 64241         (reconcile-status)

Five calls, two paths — the same two. And handle_done_command's into-Completed
transition at 9960-9984 does set_status_from_str("completed"), record_change,
update_requirement, record_role_activity and then renders the crescendo. No emission.
That is a supported completion path writing Completed to the store with no SpecCompleted
event, which is AC1's subject exactly.

SO MY EXPECTATION IS A REFUSAL, and the round that would change it is not a rebase — it
is either centralising emission at the into-Completed transition boundary or wiring the
remaining production paths, plus coverage for the omitted commands. That was the prior
finding's own remedy and I have nothing to add to it.

WHAT I WILL DO WHEN CI REPORTS: record the verdict against a2d401e3c2c9 with a sha,
which discharges the last of the five no-sha rows regardless of the outcome. That was
worth doing even if the finding stands — right now nothing can tell which head the
existing refusal applies to, and after this it will.

ONE THING I AM NOT DOING: I am not reading the other AC verifications. The prior verdict
records AC2 through AC8 as verified by tests, inspection and docs, and I have no reason
to re-derive them — the rebase changed no code. If F1 is addressed in a later round I
will check the rest properly at that point rather than carrying forward someone else's
verification into an approval.

NOTHING ELSE MOVED: 20 open, 14 BLOCKED, 4 DIRTY, 1 UNSTABLE, none unheld and mergeable.
subject: #1998 rebased and reviewable (0d55bce81c -> a2d401e3c2) — but it is a rebase, not a round: F1 still stands, emit_spec_completed is the same two paths and aida done still does not emit
